case.subject: Automated clinical trial recruitment screening
case.tool: Google Cloud Vertex AI / Healthcare Data Engine
case.problem: Researchers spend weeks manually scanning thousands of unstructured electronic health records (EHRs) to identify patients who meet specific, complex criteria for clinical trial eligibility.
case.workflow: The AI agent ingests anonymized, unstructured clinical notes and laboratory reports, maps them against specific trial inclusion/exclusion protocols, and generates a pre-screened list of potential candidates for human review.
case.result: Researchers receive a filtered shortlist of eligible candidates in minutes, significantly reducing the manual document review phase.
case.result_basis: Vendor-reported case study and healthcare industry documentation regarding clinical data interoperability.
case.measurement_context: Shift from manual, multi-week chart reviews to rapid, AI-assisted cohort identification; focus is on throughput rather than final clinical selection.
case.source_quote: Accelerate clinical trial recruitment by using AI to analyze unstructured patient data and identify eligible candidates against complex protocol criteria faster.
case.limitation: The agent only provides a recommendation; human clinicians must perform final medical validation to confirm eligibility and ethics compliance.
case.listener_action: Identify the most time-consuming 'search and match' task in your team's document workflow; create a checklist of exact criteria used to filter those documents manually.
case.availability: Available for deployment via Google Cloud Vertex AI for healthcare organizations with appropriate data governance.

case.subject: Clinical trial patient prescreening
case.problem: Manual chart review of thousands of patient records is slow, creating a major barrier to clinical trial enrollment.
case.workflow: The AI agent ingests clinical data to automatically screen incoming patients against complex trial inclusion and exclusion criteria, flagging eligible candidates for research teams.
case.result: A clinical trial site was able to screen 500 patients per month instead of 250, increasing total screening throughput.
case.result_basis: Vendor-reported case study published by Clinical AI regarding their MAIA solution.
case.measurement_context: Comparison of patient screening volume per month at a clinical trial site.
case.source_quote: In one oncology case study, MAIA™ helped enable a clinical trial site to screen all 500 patients coming into the clinic every month
case.limitation: The agent provides a recommendation; human research teams must perform final clinical validation to confirm eligibility and compliance.
case.listener_action: Identify the most time-consuming 'search and match' step in your documentation process and list the exact criteria a human uses to filter those items.
case.availability: Available on Google Cloud Marketplace as of April 2026.
